newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Housewares says yr earnings will be lower.
newsitem.headline: Housewares says yr earnings will be lower.

text.p: South African mail sales business, Housewares Ltd, said on Thursday that earnings per share for the current financial year would be lower than that achieved for the financial year ended March 31, 1996.

This profit warning follows Housewares' prediction at the interim stage in November last year that it anticipated achieving growth of approximately eight percent for the full year, subject to no deterioration in market conditions.
However, directors said they were confident that the group would, in the medium term, revert to the steady growth record achieved in the past.
Housewares' results for the year ended March 31, 1997 will be published during June.
